reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 13 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native note/right-edge crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; checked cap emblems, absence of facial hair, red collar patches/cross, frontal pose, collar, backing, and source note rows/right tab against returned marks and edge construction.

remaining_reasons: The source's small dark right-edge note tab is absent from the returned note's right edge, which instead shows only worn paper and a crease. Restore the original compact dark tab and its position/form without substituting a tear or different hardware.

The returned native note adds a separate small gray dash below and to the right of the second main mark row, outside the original two-row upper footprint. The enlarged original has no such independent lower dash. Remove that added mark and restore only the source-scale two-row upper marks and spacing.
entries.positive_observation: The dark olive-green cap retains its shiny black visor, gold cord/piping, a small upper emblem and separate lower circular wreath/cockade. Covered hair, dark brows, no glasses, no moustache or beard and one stern closed mouth remain. The near-frontal upright pose, forward gaze, crop and deep visor shadow are retained. The dark olive uniform keeps gold shoulder accents, red pale/gold-detailed collar patches and one pale-edged dark neck cross. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or pinching. The complete dark frame and opaque muted grey-olive backplate remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte ring; these correct features do not offset the clear note-tab loss and added lower dash.
entries.visible_limitations: Precise cap-badge, collar-patch and neck-cross details plus note lettering are too small to read reliably at 65x67 and are not rejection grounds. The rejection relies on the clearly visible native extra dash and missing edge tab relative to the enlarged original, not on glyph interpretation or alpha numbers.
